records.issue_text: `app/models/topic_embed.rb:36,43` — `category: eh.try(:category_id)` passes an integer where the previous value was `SiteSetting.embed_category`, a category *name*. Discourse's `PostCreator`/`TopicCreator` `:category` option historically resolves by name (`Category.query_category`), so an integer may silently fall through to uncategorized. Verify against `PostCreator` (not present in this checkout) and switch to the option that takes an id (`category_id`) if so. Also, when `eh` is nil (import for a non-registered host) the topic now lands in uncategorized with no warning.
